# dodi

> dodi is an open source, end-to-end encrypted learning platform for kids: an AI companion, learning games and a 3D companion character. Families can let their own AI agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, a local model, any agent that can run shell commands or speak MCP) build learning games, companion avatars and accessories for them with the dodi CLI.

## For agents: make games for a family

Use the dodi CLI. You play the parent's part in dodi's Game Studio: you brief dodi's own game agent and review what it builds; it writes the game with the family's AI providers (pictures, a visual check and translations included). Everything is sealed on your machine, so the dodi server never sees a family's content. Install it with `npm install -g @dodi-education/cli` (Node 20+).

1. `dodi login` prints an approval link. Send it to the parent. If it exits with code 3, run `dodi login --resume` after they approved.
2. `dodi docs` explains the workflow; `dodi docs studio` is how to brief and review. Read it before your first brief.
3. `dodi studio new "<brief>"`, answer dodi with `dodi studio plan "<answer>"` until the plan is right, then `dodi studio build`.
4. `dodi studio wait` until the build is done (exit 3 = still building, run it again). Look at the screenshots it lists, then `dodi studio send "<feedback>"` and wait again, until the game is right.
5. Only when the parent asks: `dodi games publish` submits the game to dodi Discover for every family (reviewed before it goes live).

Every command takes `--json` and exits with a meaningful code (0 ok, 3 waiting for approval or a running build, 5 log in again, 6 missing permission). `dodi mcp` runs the same commands as a local MCP server over stdio.

Rules: never put a kid's real name or personal details into a brief.

## Links

- [Source code](https://github.com/dodi-education/dodi-app): the platform, the apps and the CLI (AGPL-3.0)
- [Web app](https://app.dodi.app): where parents allow agents (Settings > Access)
